about.description: FinChain Dollar (FUSD) is a yield-bearing, USD-pegged stablecoin issued by FinChain Bermuda Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Finchain Holdings (Cayman) Limited and the Web3 arm of Fosun Wealth Holdings. Balances rebase daily via a reward multiplier while the unit price stays fixed at $1; yield accrues from a reserve of tokenised T-bill and money-market exposure held against FUSDLP. Minted 1:1 from USDT by KYC-verified wallets ($1,000 minimum, non-US). No allowlist gates holding or transfer, but the token is an upgradeable, pausable proxy, so transferability is revocable by the admin Safe. Reserve treasury coverage measured ~115% on 2026-08-14. No public attestation is obtainable: both proof-of-reserve links resolve to one dead, email-gated DocSend and no financial auditor is named in the issuer's own vendor table. Two CertiK audits (latest 2026-06-29).

events.reason: Documentation is copied from OpenEden USDO (collateralization page still refers to "USDO"). No obtainable proof of reserves; no financial auditor named. Issuer entity in submission was the Cayman holdco, corrected to the Bermuda issuer.
